note: Drop chance runes (RuneInfoData NameKey 'DropChance*'). The game stores their stat under the 'DropChance*Percent' STATTYPE: a per-level drop-chance MULTIPLIER percent (AccountStat_DropChance*Percent = '{0}% Increased ... Drop Chance Multiplier'). Every level of a node carries the same value, so the total bonus is sum(level x perLevelPercent) over purchased nodes, exactly like the other rune families. The sibling AccountStat_DropChance* keys ('+{0}%', no Percent suffix) are the flat additive variant and are NOT what these runes grant.
